name: Diego Faradenza
source: From an early age Diego hung around with all sorts of scum and quickly made a name for himself and a pretty good fortune on criminal affairs. Everyone in Dale knows him as one of the most dangerous and reckless thugs. He was permanently banned from the Lady Luck Club for stalking Adele.
